verdict.reason: Staggered grid reveal for the library index; cheap and uses real content, not placeholders.

name: Hook Sidebar
one_line: A vertical navigation list with a dashed rail that marks the active item.

verdict.reason: Superseded by our rail.

name: Matrix Orb
one_line: A dot-matrix orb that animates through idle, listening and thinking states.

verdict.reason: No job in Engrane — a maths-learning surface has no use for it.

name: Notification Bell
one_line: An iOS-style notification bell with an unread count badge.

verdict.reason: A bell with a count implies an inbox we do not have.

name: OTP Input
one_line: A one-time-code input whose characters roll into place behind a caret that slides from slot to slot.

verdict.reason: No OTP flow in the product.

name: Password Input
one_line: A password field with an eye toggle to show or hide what you type, and a strength meter that shows the password level as you type.

verdict.reason: No password surface of our own to restyle.

name: Proximity Sidebar
one_line: A dash-style scroll sidebar whose items expand as the pointer approaches.

verdict.reason: Superseded by our rail; a second sidebar pattern would be churn.

name: Rail TOC
one_line: A table of contents with a paper plane that flies to the section you're reading.

verdict.reason: A table of contents as a rail — same shape as the settings rail that just shipped, applied to long articles.

name: Scroll Progress
one_line: A scroll progress pill that tracks reading position and expands into a squircle menu of sections you can jump to.

verdict.reason: Reading progress for long articles, which the library already has.

name: Step Player
one_line: An iOS-style stepped progress track with a play, pause and replay control. The active step stretches into a bar that fills as it plays.

verdict.reason: A player for a sequence of steps — the closest thing here to a worked solution advancing one line at a time.

name: Task List
one_line: A checklist that strikes out completed tasks and moves them to the bottom of the list.

verdict.reason: Checkable task list with real state; maps to generation steps or a study checklist.

name: Theme Selector
one_line: A row of miniature app previews, one per theme, with a ring that marks the one you pick.

verdict.reason: We ship one token set by design; a theme picker would fight RULES-v2.

name: Utils
one_line: The cn helper for merging Tailwind classes.

verdict.reason: Their cn() helper: irrelevant in a Jinja2 + vanilla codebase.

name: Voice Note
one_line: A voice message bar with a scrubbable waveform and a play control.

verdict.reason: Dictation already exists as a composer control; a second audio surface is not needed.

name: Web Search
one_line: The sources behind an AI answer, shown as a search pill, source cards, a streaming answer, and inline citations.

verdict.reason: Their demo web-search chrome; our sourcing lives behind the generation job, not a results page.

Auto-height animation; the pane owns height and animating it would fight the layout.
